messages.explanation.shutdown: Shutdown must explicitly be true or false.

messages.detail.ospf_process_required: OSPF uses router ospf and network ... area ..., not ip route. Supply an explicit process ID in the Command Library; numeric tree labels are not verified process evidence.

messages.detail.dot1q_required: 802.1Q needs an Ethernet subinterface and an explicit VLAN ID. Supply the missing VLAN in the Command Library; the subinterface suffix is not automatically the VLAN ID.
messages.explanation.ipv6_disabled: Disabling IPv6 forwarding affects all IPv6 transit traffic on this device. Review before applying; no commands have been executed.
